segments.name: E&P Segment
segments.description: Explores, develops, and produces oil, gas, and NGLs onshore in the United States, deriving all revenue from these production activities.
segments.evidence: As a result of these factors, the Company has one reportable segment : the oil, gas, and NGL exploration and production segment ("E&P Segment").

revenueModel.text: The Company earns revenue from selling its share of produced oil, gas, and NGLs from its Midland Basin, South Texas, and Uinta Basin assets to purchasers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company recognizes its share of revenue from the sale of produced oil, gas, and NGLs from its Midland Basin, South Texas, and Uinta Basin assets.
